subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for ‘copious’ in the given sentence.**

To be a successful writer, you need to have plenty of words; otherwise you will write a meagre novel which won’t receive good response from the readers.
solution: The correct answer is: **Meagre**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **copious **means abundant or plentiful. (प्रचुर या भरपूर) • **Example**: *The garden produced copious amounts of vegetables during the harvest.* • The sentence suggests that to be a successful writer, one needs to have a lot of words. • The word '**meagre**' is an antonym of 'copious' and means lacking in quantity or quality. (मात्रा या गुणवत्ता में कमी) • **Example**: *The hiker had only a meagre supply of food for the long trek.* • Therefore, the sentence implies that if a writer has too few words, their novel will be meagre and not receive a good response from readers. Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Successful**: Achieving the desired outcome or achieving one's goals. (वांछित परिणाम प्राप्त करना या किसी के लक्ष्य को प्राप्त करना) • **Plenty**: A large or sufficient amount of something. (किसी चीज़ की बड़ी या पर्याप्त मात्रा) • **Response**: A reaction or reply to a stimulus or situation. (किसी उत्तेजना या स्थिति पर प्रतिक्रिया या उत्तर) 39:T64b, The correct answer is: Option 4)**
